note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), read offline from the bundled owb-am text, per the founder decision of 2026-11-18 that every Amharic work quotes OWB. Every quotation was re-quoted to it verbatim, replacing the 1962 UBS New Testament wording and the Old Testament renderings made in its register: the texts Finney names for his sermons, the verses he and the people in his story recite, and the phrases he quotes again inside his own sentences.

A `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span in that block: the whole verse or range, the shortest span carrying the quoted clause, or exact OWB pieces joined with '…'. Where OWB opens an inner quotation inside a verse, the inner marks are ‹ ›. `self_rendered` rows (each with a `why`) are allusions, the words Finney or his converts put in their own mouths, and the few recitations whose argument OWB's wording cannot carry.

Judgement calls. Jeremiah 20:7-12: Finney sets the KJV's 'thou hast deceived me' against the margin's 'enticed', and OWB itself reads 'enticed' (አባበልከኝ), so the opening clause and the margin note stay as translated and verses 7b-12 are OWB. Psalm 37:3 stays the translator's: the woman argues from 'verily thou shalt be fed', which OWB's «ታማኝነትንም ተመገብ» does not say. The text of Matthew 7:7-8 replaces the Luke 11 wording the Amharic had used (Finney's 'Ask, and ye shall receive' is Matthew). Jeremiah 29:13 'when ye search for me' is OWB «ስትሹኝም», and Finney's stress on 'when' now reads «የ‹መቼ›» … rather than a word the verse no longer has; likewise the prose that echoes Ecclesiastes 9:18 («ሊያበላሽ») and Isaiah 28:17 («የሐሰትን መጠለያዎች») follows OWB's verbs and nouns. Romans 8:7, preached twice as a text, is OWB's «የሥጋ አመለካከት ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር ጦርነት ላይ ስለ ሆነ ነው». Isaiah 28:13 keeps OWB's transliterated «ጻው ላጻው … ቃው ላቃው». The Lord's Prayer clauses are OWB Matthew 6:9-10, and the 'Thy will be done' refrain is OWB Matthew 26:42 «ፈቃድህ ይሁን» (decision thy-will-be-done). The author's own 'Jehovah' in Genesis 19's retelling follows OWB's እግዚአብሔር (decision jehovah). The tent streamer's 'Holiness to the Lord' (Exodus 28:36) is kept as an inscription.
